answers.goal: For now I’m heavily interested in anything within production, whether that be script supervising, PA-ing, or other roles like production designing and more. I’m currently taking on roles involved within development, doing script coverages, aiding as an assistant, like helping on the more administrative work, and other tedious work.
answers.drew: Film is truly the best form of storytelling. The way I feel about a cinematic masterpiece is incomparable, and nothing like anything else I’ve ever felt. That exactly is what I want to do in the future, be involved in creating these entratining stories that help people feel connected, emotional and more. The entertainment industry is so vast and large, and as an international student coming from Indonesia, it acts as a connector to different varying people, uniting us into valuable friendships.
answers.seeking: People with the same love as film as I do. I’m constantly impressed by the different people I meet on different sets I’ve been as they’ve been very interesting people with different backgrounds and stories. I want to know more about people’s experiences, whether they’re just starting out in the industry, or already well within it.
answers.inspiration: My greatest inspiration would be the incredible Curry Barker—just a college drop out with a dream. He made what he made with Obsession because of his believe in his team and himself. He had an image and a story to tell and he did just that, and AMAZINGLY.
